audit_name: OPS-02 C18 Metric Implementation, Absent-Class Logic, and Macro-Average Behavior Audit

mathematical_definitions.confusion_matrix: 12x12 integer matrix M where row index r is ground truth class, column index c is predicted class. Invalid pixels (target == -100) are strictly excluded from accumulation.
mathematical_definitions.per_class_union: Union_c = TP_c + FP_c + FN_c = GT_c + Pred_c - TP_c
mathematical_definitions.per_class_iou: IoU_c = TP_c / Union_c if Union_c > 0 else None
mathematical_definitions.macro_miou_phenomena: Mean of IoU_c for all phenomenon classes (c in 1..11) where class is eligible under absent-class rules.

absent_class_handling_comparison.c8_c10_ops01_implementation: In historical reference (exp07_reference.py), condition `if gt[c] > 0:` was used. Classes with GT == 0 were assigned None and excluded from macro average denominator.
absent_class_handling_comparison.c16_replicate003_implementation: In train_replicate003.py, condition `if denom[c] > 0:` was used. If GT == 0 but Pred > 0 (false positives), IoU was calculated as 0.0 and added to denominator.

ops02_dev_empirical_reconciliation.evidence: In the 40 DEV samples, every single one of the 11 phenomenon classes has GT > 0 (AF=39,385, BS=123,771, LWA=58,567, MCC=853,315, OF=1,709, POW=78,415, RF=9,550, WS=131,037, Eddy=45,322, IWs=579,526, HM=117 pixels). Therefore, gt[c] > 0 holds for all 11 classes, denom[c] > 0 holds for all 11 classes, and denominator is exactly 11 in both implementations.
ops02_dev_empirical_reconciliation.numerical_reproduction: Re-evaluating best_model.pt under both implementations produces identical 0.049399 DEV mIoU.

absent_class_handling_comparison.canonical_c18_rule: Under GOV-RULE-094, the authoritative rule for future training is: A class is eligible for macro-averaging if and only if GT_c > 0. If GT_c == 0 and Pred_c > 0, IoU is None (excluded from macro denominator to prevent false-alarm penalization of absent target domains). If GT_c > 0 and TP_c == 0, IoU is 0.0 (included in macro denominator as legitimate perception failure).

sparse_class_behavior_analysis.ultra_sparse_class_impact: HM has 117 ground-truth pixels across the 40 DEV samples (0.0045% of total pixels). The model predicted 0 true positives for HM, resulting in IoU_HM = 0.0. Because the macro average is unweighted across classes, HM carries exactly 1/11th (9.09%) of the total score, equal to MCC which has 853,315 pixels (32.5% of dataset).
sparse_class_behavior_analysis.zero_tp_classes: Three classes had exactly zero true positives: AF (39.4k px), RF (9.6k px), and HM (117 px). These three 0.0 scores alone pull the 11-class average down by 3/11 = 27.3% of the scale.
